newsitem.title: TOGO: Togo to sell 38 pct of state phosphate company.
newsitem.headline: Togo to sell 38 pct of state phosphate company.

text.p: The government of Togo said it was inviting offers for 38 percent of the equity of the state phosphate company.
The Office Togolais des Phosphates (OTP), which is currently wholly owned by the government, is the world's fifth largest phosphate exporter, with around 2.7 million tonnes exported in 1996.
The company hopes that potential investors will be prepared to inject fresh capital to upgrade the infrastructure as well as for expansion.
Investors are invited to submit preliminary tenders by June 20.
